description: South Africa - Power Pool Renewable Energy Zones Solar CSP is a dataset listed in energydata.info, an open data portal for energy in developing countries under the section "Renewable energy, Resource assessments", published or maintained by Grace C. Wu, Ranjit Deshmukh (Lawrence Berkeley National Laboratory). This spatial vector dataset shows areas of identified high quality potential for Concentrating Solar Power (CSP) development divided into large contiguous areas called "zones." This dataset shows all zones in the Southern Africa Power Pool (SAPP) region. Coverage: 12 countries in Sub-Saharan Africa. It has 2 files in SHP, GeoJSON. The portal files it under Renewable energy, Resource assessments, Solar. The portal gives 2015 as the release date. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support power-system and electrification planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-energydata-info-world-bank.
